changeSet.author: Artem Prokudin
changeSet.sql: create table outbox_event ( id bigint not null auto_increment, event_type varchar(100) not null, payload json not null, ordering_key varchar(255) null, status int not null, attempts int not null default 0, next_attempt_at datetime(6) not null, last_error text null, created_at datetime(6) not null, processed_at datetime(6) null, primary key (id), key ix_outbox_event_due (status, next_attempt_at), key ix_outbox_event_ordering (ordering_key, status, id) ) engine = InnoDB default charset = utf8mb4 collate = utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;
